data.body:
2026-11-02 status: stopped before claim; 2 items need the operator.
1. review-plan BLOCK (T5c, 1 blocking finding, unsigned): the recorded trade-off basis 'every client here is the shared bot account' does not match the live server. Gerrit reports 6 active accounts (admin, JoeOakhartNava, RebarBotNava, devuser, rebar-ci-bot, rebar-review-bot). infra/gerrit/project.config:33-39 grants push on refs/for/refs/heads/* to Registered Users, and gerrit.config auth.type = OAUTH with the GitHub provider has no org restriction in the committed config, so a GitHub sign-in that creates an account would be a Registered User able to upload packs. Unverified: whether the OAuth plugin auto-creates accounts for arbitrary GitHub users on this host. The decision to set the key is unchanged; the recorded rationale needs an accurate basis before the plan can pass.
2. Apply path: the documented apply (infra/runbooks/gerrit-outbound-mail.md:62-82, infra/scripts/compose-up.sh) does more than re-seed gerrit.config and restart Gerrit. compose-up.sh:175 runs 'docker compose up -d --build' for all 4 services. Read-only host check (SSM 82eab9bd-e192-4559-aa24-3c7f8c6adf03): MCP currently runs as blue-green container rebar-mcp-af769ead9feb-8092 and no compose-mcp-1 exists, so compose-up would start a second MCP backend and rebuild images. Live receive.checkReferencedObjectsAreReachable is unset (default true); the only live/repo gerrit.config difference is the substituted OAuth client-id. No host change was made.
